{{ModBox}} '''Bane of Grineer''' is a [[mod]] that increases the [[Faction Damage]] of rifles against {{Faction|Grineer}}. ==Stats== {| class="emodtable" |+ Normal |- ! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]] ! Effect ! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]] |- | 0 || x1.05 || 4 |- | 1 || x1.1 || 5 |- | 2 || x1.15 || 6 |- | 3 || x1.2 || 7 |- | 4 || x1.25 || 8 |- | 5 || x1.3 || 9 |}
{| class="emodtable" |+ [[Flawed Mods|Flawed]] |- ! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]] ! Effect ! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]] |- | 0 || x1.03 || 2 |- | 1 || x1.05 || 3 |- | 2 || x1.08 || 4 |- | 3 || x1.1 || 5 |} ==Drop Locations== {{DropLocations}} ==Notes== *Has no effect on {{Faction|Corrupted}} and {{Faction|Narmer}} Grineer (e.g. {{E|Corrupted Lancer}}, {{E|Narmer Lancer}}). *Despite being listed as a multiplier, it will stack '''additively''' with other sources of Damage to Grineer. **For example, if you had a [[Riven Mods|Riven Mod]] with x0.5 Damage to Grineer and a max rank Bane of Grineer with x1.3 Damage to Grineer, you would have a '''1 - 0.5 + 0.3 = x0.8''' multiplier for damage against Grineer with both mods equipped. ==Media== BaneofGrineerModOld.png|Old appearance {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|_wQIcGEha8k}} }} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|34.0}} *Changed the Faction Damage Mod (includes Bane, Cleanse, Expel, Smite, Railjack, and Riven Faction Stats) descriptions to use multiplier instead of percentage based stat formatting. Damage values have not changed! Just the way they are communicated. **For example: Smite Corpus (at max rank) ***Was: “+30% Damage to Corpus.” ***Now: “x1.3 Damage to Corpus.” **This change better communicates how Faction Damage is calculated, since calculation occurs when you hit the enemy, as opposed to when you shoot like other damage sources (since it needs to know what Faction is being hit). For that reason, multipliers apply to final damage as a whole and not just part of the formula! {{ver|29.10}} *Fixed the Bane Mods applying the increased Damage twice. {{ver|9.0}} *12x new Mods: ''Faction "Bane"'' (melee, pistol, shotgun, rifle). *Introduced. }} {{FactionMods}} [[de:Verderben der Grineer]] [[es:Perdición de los grineer]] [[fr:Fléau des Grinners]] [[ru:Погибель: Гринир]] [[uk:Погибель ґрінерів]] [[Category:Mods]] [[Category:Uncommon Mods]] [[Category:Faction Damage Mods]] [[Category:Rifle Mods]] [[Category:Madurai Mods]] [[Category:Update 9]] [[Category:Flawed Mods]]

{{ModBox}}
'''Combustion Beam''' is a [[mod]] that causes enemies killed by primary [[Continuous Weapon]]s to explode, dealing up to 600 {{D|Blast}} damage shortly after death.

==Stats==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]]
! Damage
! Range
! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]]
|-
| 0 || +100 || 3m || 4
|-
| 1 || +200 || 6m || 5
|-
| 2 || +300 || 9m || 6
|-
| 3 || +400 || 12m || 7
|-
| 4 || +500 || 15m || 8
|-
| 5 || +600 || 18m || 9
|}

==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
*The Explosion does '''600''' {{D|Blast}} damage in an '''18m''' radius at max rank, with '''0%''' [[Status Chance]] and '''100%''' falloff.
**Explosion requires [[Line of Sight]], and its range is '''not''' affected by ({{M|Primed Firestorm|Primed}}) {{M|Firestorm}}.
**Can break crates.
**Can trigger {{Weapon|Enkaus}}'s instakill effect.
**Can damage {{E|Arbitration Shield Drone}}s and make them explode on death.
**Explosion damage can only be increased by [[Faction Damage Bonus]] (e.g. {{M|Bane of Infested}}, {{A|Roar}}), [[Extra Hit]] abilities (e.g. {{A|Resupply}}), or [[Damage Vulnerability]] on enemies (e.g. {{A|Molecular Prime}}).
***Can hit {{A|Sonar}} weakpoints.
***Can pop {{A|Spores}} when used with {{A|Toxic Lash}}. 
***Enemies killed by spread forced [[Extra Hit]] procs will explode and spread them again.
*Combustion Beam is only usable on primary [[Continuous Weapon]]s. This includes Robotic Weapons like {{Weapon|Artax}} and {{Weapon|Verglas}}.
**A notable exception to this rule is the {{Weapon|Tenet Flux Rifle}}, because it was derived from continuous weapon ({{Weapon|Flux Rifle}}), even though its firing mechanics are similar to an automatic rifle.
**Because the {{Weapon|Panthera}}'s secondary fire has a continuous and fixed range, Combustion Beam can also be equipped on it. Enemies killed by either the primary or secondary fire will trigger the explosion.
**[[Torid Incarnon Genesis]] is still considered just {{Weapon|Torid}}, and cannot equip this mod despite having a beam fire mode.
*Combustion beam essentially functions as a weaker {{A|Molecular Prime}} (chain reaction effect), making it effective at clearing weak low level enemies very rapidly.
*Enemies killed in one instant or vaporized on death (e.g. {{E|Volatile Runner}}) will '''not''' trigger the explosion.
